_doc: Design catalogue of Ash's conditions (a proposal for native/life/conditions.json, read by native/conditions.gd). Each condition: id, name (and names per level), icon, color, kind, tone, description (Ash's own words, shown on the badge), strength {max, start, stack}, duration {decay, minutes per level / grow}, triggers (glossary.triggers), effects (one object per level; keys in glossary.effects; multipliers on the player tunables walk_speed / run_speed and on stamina), visual {anim, fx, sfx, tint}, cures (glossary.cures), interactions {worsens, eases, cancels, becomes, blocked_by}, dialogue {prefix (the dialogue.json key: people[id].cond[prefix] and fallback.cond[prefix]), weight (the pool weight in quests._ambient), react (concern | playful | proud | gentle), greet (true: a line said before the normal greeting the first time someone sees it), lines {person id | _any: [lines]}}, save (kept in the save file; level and minutes left), build {priority 1 best .. 5, phase now | next | soon | later, needs}, show (anime episodes it comes from). 'wet' and 'fatigue' belong to the first conditions worker (native/conditions.gd); they are referenced here by id only. Keys the engine doesn't know should be ignored, so this file can grow.

kinds.body: how Ash's body feels (hunger, sleep, cold, injuries)
kinds.mess: what's on him (mud, soot, honey, marker); mostly washes off; often blocks clean places
kinds.mood: how he feels; changes dialogue and small numbers; feeds the growth system (ash_arc.md section 3)
kinds.companion: a condition on a Pokemon (target: pikachu or any party member)

stack.add: a new trigger raises the level by 1 (up to max)
stack.max: a new trigger sets the level to max(current, trigger level)
stack.replace: the new trigger's level replaces the old one

decay.time: the level drops by 1 every minutes_per_level game minutes
decay.rest: drops only while resting (sitting, sleeping, in a Center or inn)
decay.leave_area: ends when the trigger area is left
decay.while_source: lasts while its source holds (Encumbered while the pack is heavy)

triggers.minutes_since_meal: game minutes since Ash last ate (meals, snacks, a Pallet House plate)
triggers.minutes_awake: game minutes since he last slept 4h+
triggers.condition_for: another condition has been active for N minutes (wet for 60 -> chilly)
triggers.in_area: standing in an area tag (sun, mud, pond, beach, tall_grass, cave, fog, smoke)
triggers.fall: a drop of N metres (route ledges, bridges, trees)
triggers.trip: running over rough ground has a chance per minute
triggers.hit_by: a move or a hazard hits Ash (thundershock, ember, sting, string_shot, stun_spore, sleep_powder, smog, sing)
triggers.event: a scripted beat (lost_battle, public_fail, gary_taunt, badge_won, farewell, letter_from_mom, encouragement)
triggers.team_rocket: a Team Rocket prank (pit, net, glue, spicy_stall)
triggers.days_away: game days since Ash was last in Pallet Town

cures.eat: any food (item with food: true); 'meal' = a proper meal (Pallet House, Brock's camp cooking, a Center canteen)
cures.drink: water: taps, fountains, a canteen item
cures.sleep: N hours in a bed / sleeping bag
cures.rest: N minutes sitting (bench, campfire, Center sofa)
cures.wash: a bath, a shower, the pond or the sea (sea and pond cure mess but make him wet)
cures.change: change clothes at home / an inn / a Center locker
cures.pokemon_center: Nurse Joy (Ash too: she patches him up while his Pokemon heal)
cures.person: talking to a caring adult / friend while the condition is active (the 'Ask' response)
cures.place: entering a place (hot springs, a warm hearth)
cures.event: a scripted beat (win, call home, find a landmark)

effects.throw: multiplier on Poke Ball throw accuracy
effects.catch: multiplier on catch rate (the Pokemon's view of Ash)
effects.blocks_entry: place ids or tags (tag:clean = homes, pallet_house kitchen, the lab, a Center ward; tag:food = bakery, stalls; tag:shop = shops; tag:formal = the lab's study, a Gym lobby, the St. Anne ballroom) that turn Ash away at the door with a line
effects.wild_flee: multiplier on how quickly wild Pokemon run from him (smelly 2.0)
effects.wild_approach: multiplier on curious wild Pokemon coming close (sticky/honey 2.0)
effects.talk_prefix: a dialogue prefix is used (see dialogue.prefix)
effects.hud: a HUD change: hide_map, hide_compass, vignette, blur, shake
effects.idle: an idle animation played now and then (yawn, sneeze, shiver, scratch, limp_stop, sigh, fist_pump)

conditions.name: Hungry
conditions.description: My stomach's louder than Pikachu.

eases.downcast: a meal while downcast drops downcast by 1 (comfort food)

delia: Have you eaten today, sweetie? Don't fib, I can hear your tummy from here.
Sit. Eat. I don't care if you're in a hurry.
Pallet House has never let a Ketchum go hungry. Not starting now.
bram: Was that your stomach or thunder? HO HO! Here, the crust end. Best part!
A hungry boy is an oven with no fire! Eat, lad!
ada: You look peaky, dear. Honey roll? Don't tell Bram, he counts them.
mae: An empty sack can't stand up, dearie. Sit, there's a biscuit in my apron.
ben: Hungry. Mm. Apple off the low branch. Ask first.
timmy: Your tummy just ROARED. Like a Snorlax! Do it again!
kai: Kid, I've got a fish sandwich and no shame. Want half?
brock: Sit down, Ash. Nobody battles on an empty stomach. Not on my watch.
_any: You look hungry, dear. Have you eaten?

conditions.name: Thirsty
conditions.description: I could drink the whole pond. Not the pond. Gross.

delia: Ash! Have you had any water today? It's warm out.
marina: You're dry as a net on the wall. Tap's by the boathouse.
_any: Hot one today. There's a tap by the plaza.

conditions.name: Sleepy
conditions.description: Five more minutes. Five more hours.

cures.note: a nap on a bench: level 1 only

becomes.level_3_sitting: falls asleep where he sits (bench, rocking chair, boat): the clock jumps 1-3h, people remark on it, Jigglypuff may doodle

delia: Ash, it's late. You need your sleep, especially now.
You're yawning so wide I can see your breakfast. Bed, mister.
mae: You've got Snorlax eyes, dearie. My rocking chair's free. Again.
kai: Don't fall asleep on my boat again, kiddo. Gus still has the log entry.
gus: Up late. Like me. But I sleep mornings. You don't, I hear.
timmy: Your eyes are doing the droopy thing! Are you gonna fall asleep STANDING? Do it!
ada: Overslept AND sleepy? Dear, that's a talent.
_any: You look done in. Get some sleep, lad.

conditions.name: In Pajamas
conditions.description: These are basically clothes. Basically.

triggers.note: leaves the house before changing after waking (the departure morning forces it)

worsens.flustered: a public fail while in pajamas starts flustered at level 2

delia: Ash! Your... you're in your pajamas. Did you even brush your teeth?
ada: Oh! Is that a new look, dear? Very... sleepy. I'll tell everyone!
timmy: You're in PAJAMAS! That's SO cool! I'm wearing mine tomorrow!
lily: Ash Ketchum. Pajamas. In public. I'm telling Nibbles.
marina: Morning, sunshine. Forget something? Like trousers?
tom: Ha! Sailed in my nightshirt once. Storm came up. Never again, lad.
_any: ...Are those pajamas?

needs: outfit swap on the player model (cloth.gd)

conditions.name: Chilly
conditions.description: My teeth are doing a drum solo.

cures.note: wearing it halves the trigger chance

delia: You're shivering! Come here. Sit by the stove. Mr. Mime, a blanket, please.
mae: Where's the scarf I knitted you, dearie? Wear it, or I'll knit you a bigger one.
gus: Cold night. Lamp room's warm. Sit, if you like. I won't talk.
ben: Cold. Mm. Barn's warmer than out here.
_any: You're blue at the edges, lad. Get yourself warm.

conditions.name: Sniffles
conditions.description: I'b dot sick. I'b FIDE.

duration.note: only drops while resting/sleeping; slowly rises again if he keeps pushing while wet or chilly

effects.note: Feverish: the story nudges him to a bed; Nurse Joy insists

cures.note: Joy: rest + medicine; Ash must stay the night
home: Delia's bed rest, honey-lemon, a day skipped

interactions.note: each sneeze has a small chance to startle a wild Pokemon away (comedy)

delia: Is that a sniffle? Ash. Ash, look at me. Bed. Now. I'm making the honey-lemon.
Oh, sweetie, you're warm.
No, don't argue. Even POKéMON Masters get tucked in.
mae: Hear that sneeze? Pidgey three yards off took fright. Honey and onion, dearie. Trust me.
rose: Feverfew for the head, chamomile for the heart. I'll leave a bundle on your step.
bram: Bless you! HO HO! And bless you again! Soup! I'll find you soup!
marina: You stayed wet too long, didn't you. Stubborn as your mother. Go home.
joy: Your POKéMON are fine, Ash. YOU are staying the night. That's not a suggestion.
timmy: Don't sneeze on me! ...Okay sneeze on me a LITTLE. Do I get sick? Is it cool?
_any: Bless you! You should be in bed, dear.

conditions.name: Sunburned
conditions.description: I look like a Krabby. A boiled one.

triggers.note: x2 faster while capless; x1.5 at the beach

effects.note: a backpack on: 'ow' bark; encumbered drains a little more

delia: Ash! Wear your cap! ...Oh, too late. You're pink as a Pecha. Aloe's on the windowsill.
rose: You're the colour of my best begonias. Here. Aloe. Pat, don't rub.
kai: Kid, you're glowing! Not in the good way! Technology has made sun cream, you know!
_any: Ooh, you caught the sun, didn't you.

conditions.name: Capless
conditions.description: Where's my hat?! I can't be a Trainer without my HAT!

triggers.note: a gust on the pier or a bridge; the cap floats away

effects.note: Ash's head looks bare; the cap appears as a pickup nearby, carried by a Pokemon, or in the water

cures.note: Delia always packs one

delia: Where's your cap? ...A Mankey? Ash. There's a spare in your bag. Front pocket. I know you.
timmy: WHERE'S YOUR HAT?! You're not Ash without the hat! Are you Ash?!
ada: No cap today, dear? Is it a new style? Should I tell people it's a new style?
_any: Lost your cap, lad? Wind's a thief round here.

needs: cap as a separate player mesh piece

conditions.name: Scraped Knee
conditions.description: It's fine. It's a battle scar. Ow.

duration.note: level 2 = untreated and stinging; treating it drops it to 1 (Bandaged), which fades on its own

effects.note: Bandaged: cosmetic + dialogue

interactions.note: a second fall while level 2 can become sore_ankle (chance 0.3)

delia: Is that a scraped knee? Come here. Hold still. It only stings because it's working.
Another plaster? You've had more plasters than birthdays, sweetie.
rose: Dirt on your nose AND your knee. Somewhere very interesting, then.
mae: Blow on it, dearie. My mother said it scares the sting away. It doesn't. But it's nice.
ben: Took a tumble. Mm. Get up slower next time.
tom: Ha! A scar's a story you get to keep. Tell it well, lad.
lily: Did you cry? You can tell me. I won't tell. I'll tell Nibbles.
_any: Ooh, nasty scrape. Get that seen to.

conditions.name: Sore Ankle
conditions.description: Hop. Hop. Hop. Okay, this is slow.

cures.note: doesn't cure: lets level 3 walk at 0.9

interactions.note: a Pokemon can help: Squirtle shell-ride, Onix/Charizard carry (story beats)

delia: You're limping! What happened? No, sit first, tell me after. Mr. Mime, ice!
ben: Limping. Mm. Lean on the gate. Doduo'll wait.
marina: Jumped off something you shouldn't have, didn't you. Sit on the crate. Boot off.
timmy: You're HOPPING! Like a Spoink! What's a Spoink? I don't know! It hops!
_any: Easy, lad. Sit down and rest that ankle.

needs: fall height from the character controller

conditions.name: Dazed
conditions.description: Why are there three Pikachu?

triggers.note: runs into a tree, an invisible Mr. Mime wall, a low branch; Psyduck collision

delia: Did you walk into Mr. Mime's wall again? Sweetie, he TELLS you where it is.
timmy: You ran into NOTHING and fell over! Do it again!
_any: You all right there? You're swaying.

needs: Mr. Mime's invisible wall as a collider (creature_mrmime.gd 'wall' act)

conditions.name: Stung
conditions.description: My arm's all fizzy and purple-y.

duration.note: level 2 does not decay; needs an antidote, a Pecha berry or a Center

delia: Was that a Weedle? Oh, honey, it's swelling. There's an antidote in your bag, side pocket.
rose: A Weedle sting? Pecha berry, crushed. My mother swore by it. So do I.
lily: Weedle aren't MEAN, they're scared. Nibbles never stings. Nibbles CAN'T sting. Still.
joy: Hold still. A little antidote... there. Next time, back away slowly from Weedle, Ash.
_any: That sting looks angry. Get some antidote on it.

needs: wild Weedle on Route 2 / Viridian Forest

conditions.name: Tingly
conditions.description: I can't feel my... anything. Ha. Ha. Help.

effects.note: stiff-legged shuffle

_any: Why are you walking like a Sudowoodo, lad?

conditions.name: Drowsy
conditions.description: Butterfree's powder smells like... bed...

triggers.note: Jigglypuff: straight to asleep, then doodled

cures.note: Pikachu's helpful shock wakes him up (cures drowsy, gives zapped)

_any: Wake up, lad! You're nodding like a Doduo.

conditions.name: Stuffed
conditions.description: I ate the whole buffet. The WHOLE buffet.

bram: THREE loaves?! HO HO! That's my boy! Well. Delia's boy. Everyone's boy!
delia: Slow down, sweetie! The food isn't going anywhere. Neither are you, for a bit.
_any: Someone's been eating well!

conditions.name: Spicy Mouth
conditions.description: HOT HOT HOT HOT WATER WATER

effects.note: he runs about blowing; can't talk properly

cures.note: Squirtle/Staryu helps, gives wet

_any: Water! Someone get the boy some water!
bram: MILK, lad! Not water! Milk! HO HO HO!

conditions.name: Seasick
conditions.description: The sea is going up and down. So is my breakfast.

cures.note: 'Eyes on the horizon, lad.' halves it

tom: Eyes on the horizon, lad! Never the waves. The horizon never moves. Mostly.
kai: Ha! You're greener than a Bellsprout! Breathe! Through the nose! Technology can't fix this one!
marina: Over the side, not on my nets. Good lad.
_any: Oh dear, the sea doesn't agree with you.

conditions.name: Muddy
conditions.description: It's not mud, it's camouflage.

duration.note: level 1 brushes off on its own after 60 min of walking on grass; 2+ needs a wash

effects.note: Grimer and Diglett find him interesting

cures.note: Squirtle hoses him: becomes wet

interactions.note: shares the 'turned away at the door' plumbing with wet

delia: Stop! Right there! Not one muddy foot on my clean floor. Hose. Garden. Go.
Were you rolling with the Doduo again? You were. You've got feathers IN the mud.
ben: Mud. Mm. Good soil, that. Shame to waste it on a boy.
bram: Not in the bakery, lad! I love you, but not in the bakery! HO HO!
ada: Ash! You look like a Diglett! I'm telling your mother. Lovingly.
rose: You're wearing half my flowerbed. The good half.
timmy: You're a MUD MONSTER! Can I be one? I'm gonna be one!
lily: Nibbles says you smell like a puddle. He's being nice about it.
marina: Into the sea with you. No, I mean it. Rinse off, then talk.
mrmime: (Mr. Mime mimes a bucket. Then pours it over you. You're not wet. You feel wet anyway.)
_any: You're covered in mud, lad! Go and wash.

needs: area tag mud: the pond edge, Ben's farmyard, Route 1 puddles after rain

conditions.name: Dusty
conditions.description: Team Rocket dug ANOTHER hole.

cures.note: he beats it off with his broom

_any: Fell in a hole, did you? Again?
mrmime: (Mr. Mime beats the dust off you with his broom. Thoroughly. Too thoroughly.)

conditions.name: Sooty
conditions.description: Charmander did it. ...It was a little bit my fault.

duration.note: level 1 (Singed: a smoking hat) fades in 20 min

triggers.note: disobedient Charmeleon/Charizard: the show's recurring gag

effects.note: hair sticks out; a little smoke from the cap

worsens.flustered: if it happens in public, flustered +1

delia: Ash! You're black as the stove! Was it the Charmander? It was the Charmander.
Bath. Now. And tell your POKéMON I said 'gently, please'.
bram: You look like my oven door! HO HO! Overbaked! Bit crispy round the edges!
gus: Smoke. Logged. ...Are you all right? Not logged. Just asking.
kai: Whoa! Did something EXPLODE? Was it technology? Tell me it was technology!
timmy: You got FLAMETHROWERED?! That's the coolest thing EVER! Does it hurt? Is it cool?
brock: Hold still. ...Charizard, we need to talk about your aim.
_any: Good heavens, lad, you're smoking!

needs: a fire Pokemon in the party

conditions.name: Zapped
conditions.description: Pikachu... why... I just wanted a HUG.

duration.note: Staticky (1) = hair standing up, little sparks when he touches metal

triggers.note: the classic gag: hugging a grumpy Pikachu, low trust, or on request
EP016: 'shock me so I can think!' gives Fired Up for a minute

effects.note: sparks off metal: gates, mailboxes
a few seconds frozen, then a stagger; hair smokes

worsens.wet: being wet doubles the level (wet + zap = level 3)

delia: Your hair is... standing up. Was it the POKéMON? Sweetie, he's very yellow and very cross.
kai: WHOA. You're conductive, kid! Can I plug the radio into you? Kidding! ...Mostly!
ben: Smell of burnt hair. Mm. Pikachu?
timmy: You LIT UP! I SAW YOUR BONES! Can Pikachu do me next? PLEASE?
lily: Nibbles has never once electrocuted me. Just saying.
mae: Lightning in a teacup, that one. Hold him like you'd hold a hot kettle, dearie.
_any: Is your hair supposed to do that?

needs: Pikachu companion (companions.gd) with a mood/trust value

conditions.name: Sticky
conditions.description: Caterpie's String Shot is REALLY strong. Good job Caterpie. Help.

duration.note: level 2 (Stuck): stuck in place until he wriggles free (button mash) or someone cuts him loose

triggers.note: honey: wild_approach x2 (Pokemon come to lick him)

effects.note: struggle prompt; Pikachu or a passer-by helps

cures.note: 'Nibbles, let him GO.' (level 1 String Shot from Nibbles)
burns the web off: becomes sooty 1

lily: NIBBLES! We do NOT String Shot our friends! ...He likes you. That's how he says it.
rose: Hold still, dear, I've got garden scissors. Don't wriggle. Don't. Wriggle.
ada: Ash, you're covered in string! Are you a parcel? Should I deliver you?
_any: What on earth are you tangled up in?

needs: Nibbles's String Shot as a companion act (Lily's quest q_butterfree is the natural place)

conditions.name: Smelly
conditions.description: Muk hugged me. Muk loves me. Nobody else does right now.

duration.note: level 1 airs out in 30 min outdoors

effects.note: NPCs step back a pace; Pidgey scatter

delia: Oh! Oh, sweetie. Oh, that's... Bath. Bath first, hug after. I promise the hug.
marina: And I thought MY hands smelled of fish. Downwind, lad. Downwind.
bram: Not near the dough! It'll never rise again! HO-hoof!
rose: Lavender soap. Take the whole bar. Take two.
ben: Mm. Pig pen smells better. No offence.
timmy: EW! You smell like a BOOT! A hero boot! Still ew!
_any: Phew! What have you been rolling in?

needs: Muk or Koffing later; fish smell at the pier works now

conditions.name: Doodled
conditions.description: Why is everyone laughing? Is there something on my face?

triggers.note: Pallet: Timmy draws a moustache on him while he naps under the pond tree (needs sleepy 3 + nap at the pond)

effects.note: Ash doesn't know; only a mirror, a puddle reflection or someone telling him reveals it (the badge shows '???' until then)

delia: Ash, hold still. There's... a moustache. On your face. Did you draw a moustache on your face?
ada: Ha! Oh, dear! Oh, I mustn't. Oh, I'm going to tell EVERYONE.
tom: Fine moustache, lad! Better than mine at your age. Better than mine NOW.
gus: ...There's ink on your face. A Pidgey. Quite good, actually.
lily: Pfffff. Nothing. There's NOTHING on your face. Pfffffff.
timmy: I didn't do it! ...It was a JIGGLYPUFF! A pink one! With a marker! ...Okay it was me.
_any: Pfft. Er, nothing, lad. Nothing at all.

conditions.name: Flustered
conditions.description: Nobody saw that. Everybody saw that.

triggers.note: falling in the pond / off the pier in view of 2+ people; missing a throw in front of Gary

effects.note: he mutters; dialogue choices get an 'act cool' option
he avoids crowds: the camera prefers back paths; townspeople soften

worsens.downcast: flustered 3 + a lost battle starts downcast at 2

mae: Red as a radish, dearie. Everyone falls in the pond once. I did. At sixty.
rose: Embarrassment is a seedling, Ash. Ignore it and it wilts by teatime.
tom: Fell off the pier, eh? Ha! Proper sailor's baptism. Now you're one of us.
delia: Oh, honey. Come here. ...No? Okay. I'll just stand very close and not hug you.
timmy: That was SO embarrassing! ...It was also really cool. Both!
lily: It's okay. When I tried to evolve Nibbles by singing, Timmy saw. We don't talk about it.
_any: Chin up, lad. Happens to all of us.

needs: a 'seen by' check (life.gd knows who's near)

conditions.name: Downcast
conditions.description: Gary always wins. I'm never gonna... never mind.

duration.note: level 1 fades in 3h; 2-3 need a person, a call home, food plus rest, or a story beat

triggers.note: Oak's phone report (EP025), Gary's 10 badges (EP063)
after releasing a Pokemon: a gentler variant, 'Wistful'

effects.note: Curled Up: the player is in bed (a scripted scene); the scene is about who comes to the door (ash_arc.md 5.5)

delia: You've got your 'I lost' face on. I know it well. You wore it every time Gary beat you at conkers.
I'm not going to fix it, sweetie.
I'm just going to make cocoa, and you're going to drink it.
mae: The tide goes out, dearie. It always comes back in. Every single time. I've checked.
ben: Lost one. Mm. Wheat lodges in a storm. Stands up again after. Takes a day.
tom: I ran aground three times before I ever crossed to Cinnabar, lad. Three. The sea doesn't mind.
rose: A frost isn't the end of a garden, Ash. It's just a winter.
bram: Bad batch, eh? I burn a tray a week! HO HO! Then I bake another. That's all baking is!
timmy: You LOST? ...That's okay. You're still my hero. Heroes lose in the MIDDLE. Then they win.
brock: Hey. Sit down. ...You don't have to talk. I'll make rice balls.
_any: Chin up, lad. Tomorrow's a new day.

needs: for now: failing a chase or a catch triggers level 1

conditions.name: Fuming
conditions.description: I'm NOT mad. I'm just going to walk REALLY FAST.

effects.note: rash choices: battles start without the menu's 'think' option; Primeape copies him

ben: Steam coming off you. Mm. Count the fence posts. All of 'em.
mae: Anger's a kettle, dearie. Let it whistle, then take it off the stove.
bram: Somebody's proving like a hot dough! HO HO! Punch it down, lad!
_any: Whoa there, lad. Who rattled your cage?

conditions.name: Jitters
conditions.description: My tummy's full of Butterfree. Big ones.

duration.note: ends when the big event starts or is over

triggers.note: EP077: hearing all of Pallet is cheering makes it worse

effects.note: can't sleep: sleep cures only half

delia: Nervous? Good. That means it matters. I was nervous the day I opened the terrace for the first time.
gus: Every ship that leaves rattles a little. It's the ones that don't rattle you worry about.
_any: Nerves, lad? Breathe. You'll be fine.

conditions.name: Spooked
conditions.description: I'm not scared. I'm... cautious. Loudly cautious.

triggers.note: the Cinnabar mansion rumour

effects.note: jumpy: random startle animation; Pikachu clings to his cap (a bonding beat)

cures.note: any company
whistling a tune halves it

gus: Dark out. The lamp's on. It's always on. Walk toward it.
tom: Ghost? Ha! Probably a Hoothoot with a cold. Probably.
ada: Did you see the ghost?! Marina saw a ghost! Or Kai did. Someone saw a ghost!
_any: Out late, lad? Stick to the lit path.

needs: light levels from the day cycle

conditions.name: Homesick
conditions.description: Mom's stew. The hall light. Mr. Mime's terrible sweeping. ...I'm fine.

duration.note: never at level 2 two nights running; gentle, not a grind

triggers.note: a stew at a Center canteen; Brock's cooking
being ill away from home
EP027: 'reminded of his own mother'

effects.note: journal opens on a 'home' prompt
the videophone icon pulses on the map

cures.note: Brock cooks something 'like your mom's': level 1

eases.downcast: a call home while both are active also lowers downcast

joy: The videophone's free tonight, Ash. Somebody at home would love to hear you.
brock: You've been staring at that stew like it owes you money. ...Tastes like your mom's, huh.
misty: You're quiet. It's weird. ...Call her, you dummy. I'll watch Pikachu.
_any: Missing home, son? There's a phone at the Center.

conditions.name: Fired Up
conditions.description: I'm gonna be a POKéMON MASTER!

triggers.note: a townsperson's 'ash' line about his spark, once a day per person, adds 1

timmy: You've got the LOOK! The champion look! Do the throw! The spinny one!
bram: Now THAT'S an oven at full heat! Go get 'em, lad!
delia: Look at you. You're glowing. ...Socks. Just checking. Go on, go!
gus: Good light in you today. I'll note it.
_any: Someone's in high spirits!

needs: the existing 'ash' encouragement lines (dialogue.json) as triggers

conditions.name: Proud of Himself
conditions.description: I helped. I actually helped!

triggers.note: any helping quest (Bread Round, Lost Twine...)

effects.note: walk animation: a little bounce; townspeople react

ada: You've got a spring in your step, dear! I'll tell everyone why! Once I know why!
_any: Someone's pleased with himself. Good on you.

conditions.name: Feeling Bad
conditions.description: That was my fault. I need to fix it.

triggers.note: EP081: Pidgeotto
Kai's rod

effects.note: an 'apologise' option appears with the wronged person; the quest log shows a 'Make it right' entry

delia: You've got your 'I did something' face on. ...Do you want to tell me, or tell whoever it was?
kai: About the rod? Kid, it's fine. ...It'd be MORE fine if you said sorry, though.
mae: Sorry is a small word, dearie. It carries a lot.
_any: Something on your mind, lad?

conditions.name: Doubting
conditions.description: Did I really earn that badge?

triggers.note: Boulder, Cascade, Marsh, Rainbow in the show

effects.note: the badge case shows that badge dimmed until the doubt is answered; no stat effect

cures.note: e.g. saved Erika's Gloom

delia: A badge is a badge, sweetie? Hm. Or is a badge a promise? I think it's a promise.
brock: I gave you that badge because of what you did AFTER the battle. Remember that.
_any: Something troubling you, lad?

conditions.name: Heavy Pack
conditions.description: Why did Mom pack FOUR sweaters?

effects.note: Pikachu refuses to ride on the pack

cures.note: mail extra items to Mom (Ada's delivery round brings them; Delia comments)
eating food lightens the pack

interactions.note: level 3 + muddy slope = a slide gag

delia: Is the bag too heavy? I may have... over-packed. A little. Leave the iron, sweetie. Keep the socks.
ben: Carrying the farm on your back. Mm. Leave a bit. Roads are long.
tom: A sailor packs light, lad! A knife, a rope, a good story. You've got a teapot.
timmy: I'll carry it! ...I can't lift it. What's IN here? Is it a SNORLAX?
kai: Ooh, that's a lot of gear! Good gear? Show me the gear!
brock: You know I carry a whole kitchen, right? It's about HOW you pack. Give it here.
_any: That pack's nearly bigger than you, lad!

conditions.name: Carrying Pikachu
conditions.description: Hang on, buddy. Hang on. We're almost there.

triggers.note: voluntary: carrying a tired Pikachu restores Pikachu's trust a little

effects.note: can't throw or use items; doors open with an elbow; for pikachu_hurt the route is marked to the nearest Center or the lab

worsens.wet: rain doesn't make it worse; it makes it more dramatic (music)

interactions.growth: pokemon_hurt; carrying through rain = courage + heart

delia: Ash! Is he hurt? Go, go, go to the lab, I'll call ahead! RUN, sweetie!
ben: Give him here— no. You carry him. He wants you. Go.
joy: Chansey, a stretcher! You did the right thing bringing him straight here, Ash.
jenny: Get on the bike, kid. Hold on to him. Hold on to me.
_any: Is that POKéMON hurt? Hurry, lad!

conditions.name: Lost
conditions.description: The map says... the map is upside down. No, I'M upside down.

effects.note: the map shows a fuzzy 'you are somewhere here' blob
spooked can start at night

cures.note: the route sign, the lighthouse beam (Gus!), a river to follow, Oak's lab roof
asking for directions
a flying partner shows the way

interactions.note: night + lost + wet is the 'Charmander in the rain' scene template

gus: If you're ever lost at night, find my beam. It sweeps every twelve seconds. Count. Walk toward it.
ben: Turned around? Mm. River runs to the sea. Sea's home.
_any: Lost, are you? Pallet's that way, lad, follow the path.

needs: Gus's beam is already a world feature (the lighthouse)

conditions.name: In Disguise
conditions.description: Nobody will EVER recognise me. Hi, I'm... Ashley.

triggers.note: story: 'Ashley' at the Celadon Gym, the Mr. Mime suit at the circus; Pallet test: Delia's sunhat + Rose's shawl for a Timmy prank

effects.note: people use their 'stranger' lines; blocks_entry is lifted for places he was banned from; Pikachu always recognises him

delia: Oh, hello, dear! Are you new in town? You have my son's ears. And his shoes. ...Ash.
ada: Who's this? A visitor! I must find out EVERYTHING. What's your name, dear?
mrmime: (Mr. Mime looks at you. He mimes taking off a mask. Then points at you. Then winks.)
_any: Hello there, stranger! Passing through?

conditions.name: Netted
conditions.description: Prepare for trouble? I'm ALREADY in trouble.

triggers.note: Pallet: tangled in Marina's drying nets on the pier

effects.note: struggle prompt; Pikachu chews through (EP039) or a Pokemon cuts it; Team Rocket's motto plays

cures.note: 'Hold STILL, these are my good nets.'

marina: Hold STILL. Those are my good nets. You're the worst fish I ever caught.
kai: Ha! Biggest catch of the season! Marina, get the camera! Technology!
_any: Need a hand out of there, lad?

needs: Marina's nets on the pier for a Pallet version

conditions.name: Pikachu Hurt
conditions.description: He's hurt. Because of me. We have to get help.

triggers.note: EP047

effects.note: Pikachu can't walk: carrying_pikachu starts; Pikachu's mood frozen; all 'ash' dialogue swaps to concern

cures.note: EP012

becomes.cured: pikachu trust +1 if he carried him the whole way

_any: Oh no, is he hurt? Go! Quickly!

conditions.name: Pikachu Sulking
conditions.description: He's not talking to me. He's facing the wall. On purpose.

triggers.note: trying to put him in the ball

effects.note: Pikachu walks a few metres behind, won't sit on the shoulder or the pack, refuses commands 50%; a hug = zapped

cures.note: EP042; the fastest cure

delia: Is he sulking? He's sulking. You get that from me. ...Try an apple. Or ketchup. He likes ketchup, honey, I don't know why.
lily: Nibbles sulks too. You have to say sorry with a LEAF. Do you have a leaf?
_any: Your little friend looks cross with you, lad.

npc_conditions._doc: The same system on townspeople (life.gd), for Delia's chapter and for life in town. Only cosmetic badges and their own lines; no stats.

examples.when: after her first swim to the buoy (ash_arc 5.4)
examples.line: I DID it! Marina, did you see? Gus, LOG it!
Don't look at my hair. The sea and I have an understanding now.
Burnt a tray! HO HO! The ovens have opinions today.
Logged: keeper, one sneeze. Lamp unaffected.
...And the serpent said... zzz... hm? I'm awake, lad.
